faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know before running a check.
faq_a1: A VIN check searches third-party databases — auctions, insurance filings, and marketplace listings — using a vehicle's unique 17-character identification number to reveal its history.
faq_a2: We specialize in USA and South Korea — two of the world's largest used-car export markets. Reports pull from auction, marketplace, and national insurance sources.
faq_a3: Most reports are delivered within seconds. In rare cases, while our system is still checking available databases, delivery may take longer — we'll email you when your report is ready.
faq_a4: We aggregate data from auctions, insurance providers, and marketplace databases. We do not estimate or generate data — every record is sourced from a provider.
faq_q5: What exactly is in the report?
faq_a5: Each report includes: odometer readings over time, accident and damage records, salvage or write-off status, theft and police flags, owner count history, and vehicle photos where available.
faq_a6: Yes. All payments are processed through PayPal's secure checkout. We never store card details on our servers.
faq_a7: Yes. If no history data is found for your VIN, we offer a full refund — no questions asked.
faq_q8: Do I need an account to buy a report?
faq_a8: Yes — a free account is required so your reports are saved and accessible any time from your dashboard.
